text.tspan: Region failover only works if region B was built before region A died
Aurora writer / RDS primary · S3 · ECR
Argo CD + CI must NOT live only here
EKS cluster B, synced from the same Git (ApplicationSet)
ECR replica · S3 CRR · replica secrets · Velero backups
Runbook: confirm it's the region → freeze deploys → promote the database (accept RPO) → scale up B → DNS shifts → verify → plan fail-back.
Strategy by RTO/RPO: backup & restore (hours) · pilot light · warm standby (minutes) · active-active (~0, hardest data design).
Don't stretch one cluster across regions (etcd latency). Practise with game days.
